subject.title: feat(google-meet): retain the full caption transcript per session (#103387)

question: Should Google Meet expose post-meeting transcripts as a runtime-memory-only contract capped at 2000 lines and four ended sessions?
rationale: The implementation can enforce either an explicitly ephemeral contract or durable SQLite storage, but repository policy and source inspection cannot choose how much meeting history users should expect OpenClaw to preserve.

options.title: Accept bounded memory
options.body: Keep the current caps and explicit loss signals, require live lifecycle proof, and document restart and eviction loss as supported behavior.

options.title: Require durable storage
options.body: Pause the API and persist transcripts through plugin-owned SQLite or KV before promising post-meeting retrieval.

options.title: Limit active-session retrieval
options.body: Remove post-meeting retention and expose only explicitly ephemeral incremental captions while a session is active.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded memory
recommendation.body: Keep the current caps and explicit loss signals, require live lifecycle proof, and document restart and eviction loss as supported behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history most strongly connects steipete to the plugin, caption collector, and session-runtime contract.
